whatIs: Web Check is an OSINT and security tool: you enter a site's URL and within seconds it shows information such as the server's IP and location, DNS records, SSL certificate, HTTP headers, cookies, technologies used, open ports, WHOIS and email configuration.
It's a good fit when you want to understand how a site is built, yours or someone else's, or run a quick security and configuration check.
uses: Check your site's certificate, HSTS and security headers before launching it.
Verify a domain's DNS records and email configuration (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
Find out which technologies, servers and third-party services a site uses.
caveats: It's a diagnostic tool: the results give you direction but don't replace a security audit.
Some checks, such as the port scan or traceroute, generate traffic to the analyzed server; use them on your own sites or with permission.
Several checks depend on external APIs with usage limits; if you self-host it, you can add your own keys to raise them.
pricingNote: Free and open source under the MIT license; you can self-host it with Docker or on platforms like Netlify and Vercel.
idealFor: Quickly checking a website's configuration and security.
